Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Romeo 5000 is built upon a 120-rated Light Fusion Engine and Endo Steel frame, saving weight to carry a center torso mounted Medium Pulse Laser, an SRM-2 in each side torso and twin ER Small Lasers in each arm. Clad in three tons of armor, Romeo 5000 carries two tons of SRM reloads and is fitted with ten double heat sinks. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 罗密欧5000建立在一具120级轻型聚变引擎和内层钢框架上，省出的重量用于中央躯干一门中型脉冲激光器、两侧躯干各一具SRM-2以及双臂各两门增程小型激光器。它披挂三吨装甲，携带两吨SRM备用弹，并装有十具双重散热器。 特质: 改进生命维持 投放成本倍率: 0.99 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A favorite tool of planetary governments through out the Periphery, the Louse is designed for riot suppression. Capable of dispersing riots with lethal and non lethal options, it works well against civilians and lightly armed vehicles while posing no significant threat to actual battlemechs or military grade vehicles. Dual grenade launchers and a mixed laser package provide the bulk of the firepower, whilst a pair of flare launchers provides additional deterrent and can be used defensively in combat. Spall lined armor provides additional protection against infantry grade weapons and a set of sensors designed specifically for peering through cluttered urban environments round out the package. Often deployed as scouts and support forces; this mech is a common sight amongst the pirate bands who find themselves facing it across the battlefield. Not designed for battle, it is nonetheless pressed into service by desperate militias and governments that lack real battlemechs. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为外缘各地行星政府钟爱的工具，虱子是为镇压暴乱而设计的。它能以致命或非致命手段驱散暴乱，对付平民与轻武装车辆很有效，却对真正的战斗机甲或军用级车辆构不成重大威胁。两具榴弹发射器和一套混合激光器组提供主要火力，另有两只照明弹发射器提供额外威慑，也可在战斗中用于防御。崩落内衬装甲提供对步兵级武器的额外防护，一套专为透视杂乱城市环境而设计的传感器补全该套件。它常被用作侦察与支援力量；在那些发现自己要正面迎战它的海盗团伙中很常见。它并非为战斗而设计，却仍被缺乏真正战斗机甲、走投无路的民兵与政府硬推上阵。 特质: 改进生命维持 投放成本倍率: 0.97 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Gray Noton's infamous 'Legend-Killer' used LosTech, outfitted with an 240-rated XL engine and built on an Endo Steel frame to free up the weight to swap the classic RFL-3N's AC/5s for LB-X Autocannon/10s fed with three tons of reloads. With the RFL-3N's Large and Medium Lasers retained, the remaining weight saved after the LB-X autocannons goes towards an extra half ton of armor while a swap to double heat sinks gives it unexpected endurance in the arenas. Quirk: Legend Killer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 格雷·诺顿那台臭名昭著的“传奇杀手”使用了失传科技：它装有一具240级XL引擎，建在内层钢框架上，省出的重量用于把经典RFL-3N的AC/5换成LB-X自动炮/10，并配三吨备用弹。RFL-3N的大型与中型激光器被保留，LB-X自动炮之后省下的重量则用于额外半吨装甲，而改用双重散热器则赋予它在竞技场中出人意料的续航力。 特质: 传奇杀手 投放成本倍率: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed in 2852, this variant transforms the Phoenix Hawk IIC into a missile boat. It removes all the weapons and a ton of armor to mount four LRM-20s and eight tons of ammunition. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一改型研发于2852年，把凤凰鹰IIC变成一艘导弹艇。它拆掉所有武器和一吨装甲，以安装四具LRM-20和八吨弹药。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.18

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A cross between the primary configuration and the Phoenix Hawk IIC 2, this variant carries an Ultra AC/10 in the right torso and a pair of LRM-20s in the left torso. A Machine Gun is mounted in the head and the center torso. The missile launchers carry four tons of ammunition, the autocannon has two tons of ammunition and the machine guns have half a ton of ammunition. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是主配置与凤凰鹰IIC 2的杂交，右躯干装一门超速AC/10，左躯干装两具LRM-20。头部和中央躯干各装一挺机枪。导弹发射器配四吨弹药，自动炮配两吨弹药，机枪配半吨弹药。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.18

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally built as a new assault class mech by Clan Steel Viper just three years before the introduction of the Omnimech, the Phoenix Hawk IIC is based on the venerable 45 ton Phoenix Hawk but almost twice as heavy at 80 tons. The Phoenix Hawk IIC features as close as possible ground speed and agility to the original Phoenix Hawk making it an effective fast interdiction unit. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凤凰鹰IIC最初由钢蝰蛇氏族在全方位机甲推出仅三年前作为新型突击级机甲建造，它以古老的45吨凤凰鹰为基础，重量却几乎翻倍，达到80吨。凤凰鹰IIC拥有尽可能接近原版凤凰鹰的地面速度与灵活性，使其成为高效的快速阻截单位。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.18

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by Clan Goliath Scorpion, the Phoenix Hawk PHX-1-EC was an upgrade of the earlier PHX-1. Designed at the start of the Golden Age, the PHX-1-EC is built around a 270-rated Fusion Core and is armed with an Improved Large Laser. A pair of prototype ER Medium Lasers and an AMS make up the rest of the PHX-1-EC’s weapons. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由蝎狮氏族研发，凤凰鹰PHX-1-EC是早期PHX-1的升级版。它设计于黄金时代之初，围绕一具270级聚变核心建造，武装为一门改进型大型激光器。一对原型增程中型激光器和一套AMS构成PHX-1-EC其余的武器。 特质: 改进通讯 投放成本倍率: 1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: First introduced by the Terran Hegemony in 2568, the Phoenix Hawk was one of the most well known BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere. The 'Mech began life when Orguss Industries realized that it could reinforce the Stinger chassis to create a larger version, one with the same speed and maneuverability as the Stinger but with superior armor, firepower and electronics. Though not without its own drawbacks, the Phoenix Hawk quickly became the standard by which all other reconnaissance 'Mechs were measured. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凤凰鹰由地球霸权于2568年首次推出，是内天体最著名的战斗机甲之一。它诞生于奥古斯工业意识到可以强化毒刺底盘造出一个更大版本——速度与机动性与毒刺相同，却拥有更优的装甲、火力与电子设备。尽管自身也有缺点，凤凰鹰很快成为衡量所有其他侦察机甲的标准。 特质: 改进通讯 投放成本倍率: 1.01

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Royal Phoenix Hawk or Phoenix Hawk Special was an upgraded model of the stable of the SLDF forces. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 皇家凤凰鹰（或称凤凰鹰特型）是SLDF部队编制中的升级型号。 特质: 改进通讯 投放成本倍率: 1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan Buster upgrade, the Phoenix Hawk 1bC was a Comstar refit built with damaged Phoenix Hawk 1b’s inherited from the 112th Royal Hussar regiment of the SLDF. Powered by a 270 XL Engine and possessing an Endo Steel chassis, the PHX-1bC is armed with an ER Large Laser and a pair of Medium Lasers. A Narc Beacon and 4 tons of ammo allow the Mech to spot for allied artillery and support assets, while a Flamer gives the Mech some anti-infantry capability. The 1b’s CASE and Guardian ECM are retained. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一款“灭族者”升级，凤凰鹰1bC是康星的改装版，用从SLDF第一一二皇家骠骑兵团继承来的受损凤凰鹰1b建造。PHX-1bC由一具270 XL引擎驱动，拥有内层钢底盘，武装为一门增程大型激光器和两门中型激光器。一具Narc信标和4吨弹药让该机甲能为友军炮兵与支援资产标定目标，而一具火焰喷射器赋予它一定的反步兵能力。1b的CASE与守卫者ECM被保留。 特质: 改进通讯 投放成本倍率: 1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Royal Phoenix Hawk or Phoenix Hawk Special was an upgraded model of the stable of the SLDF forces, this model was just beginning testing and deployment before the Exodus. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 皇家凤凰鹰（或称凤凰鹰特型）是SLDF部队编制中的升级型号，该型号在出走之前才刚刚开始测试与部署。 特质: 改进通讯 投放成本倍率: 1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan modified Phoenix Hawk, most likely brought from the Inner Sphere during their exodus. One Large and two Medium Pulse Lasers are tied to a targeting computer for improved performance. Two ER Small Lasers are mounted for self-defense against infantry and lightly armored units. The design also mounts a MASC, Active Probe and ECM Suite. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一台经过氏族改装的凤凰鹰，很可能是在出走期间从内天体带来的。一门大型和两门中型脉冲激光器接在瞄准计算机上以提升性能。两门增程小型激光器用于自卫，对付步兵与轻装甲单位。该设计还装有MASC、主动探测器和一套ECM。 特质: 改进通讯 投放成本倍率: 1.07

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 1D variant of the Phoenix Hawk was commonly used by the forces of House Davion. Introduced in 2856, it removes both of the machine guns and the ammunition and replaces them with two additional heat sinks. While removing a small amount of the 'Mech's short-range firepower and a powerful set of weapons against infantry, the additional heat sinks made the 1D's heat load more manageable. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凤凰鹰的1D改型常被达维昂家族的部队使用。它于2856年推出，拆掉两挺机枪及其弹药，换成两具额外散热器。这虽然去掉了该机甲一小部分近距离火力和一套对步兵很有效的武器，但额外散热器让1D的热负荷更易管理。 特质: 改进通讯 投放成本倍率: 1.01

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A special variant used by the Gray Death Legion. Using Clan tech it manages to fit an ER Large and two ER Medium lasers together with two heavy Machine Guns, yet still keep it well armored. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是灰死军团使用的一种特殊改型。它使用氏族科技，设法把一门增程大型激光器、两门增程中型激光器和两挺重型机枪装在一起，同时仍保持良好装甲。 特质: 改进通讯 投放成本倍率: 1.09

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Blue Shot Weapons special, the Phoenix Hawk 1GS is a custom order variant based on the STR-3G Stinger. Popular among rookie pilots, the 1GS trades range and firepower for increased survivability and an easier heat curve. Built from salvaged PHX-1D’s, the 1GS strips out the XL Engine and extra DHS. The weapons are replaced with a Large Laser and a Small Laser in each arm, the additional range of the ER’s not being needed in the close quarter fighting of the Arena. Both the primary lasers are mounted in gunpods giving the variant its "Gunslinger" nickname. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为蓝射武器公司的特制品，凤凰鹰1GS是以STR-3G毒刺为基础的定制订购改型。它在新手飞行员中很受欢迎，用射程与火力换取更高的生存力和更平缓的热量曲线。1GS由打捞的PHX-1D拼建而成，拆掉XL引擎和额外的双重散热器。武器换成双臂各一门大型激光器和一门小型激光器，因为在竞技场的近距离战斗中并不需要增程型号的额外射程。两门主激光器都装在枪荚里，为该改型赢得了“神枪手”的绰号。 特质: 改进通讯 投放成本倍率: 1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The PXH-1GU is a ComStar variant, nicknamed 'Special', that mounts two light blazers as its main weapons, with two small lasers and two machine guns as shorter range burst options. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: PXH-1GU是康星的一种改型，绰号“特型”，以两门轻型聚焦激光为主武器，另有两门小型激光器和两挺机枪作为近距离点射选项。 特质: 改进通讯 投放成本倍率: 1.01

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 1K variant was particularly favored by House Kurita, though when it was introduced in 2603 it represented a departure from the traditional thinking of the Phoenix Hawk. By removing all jump jets from the 'Mech, room is freed up to install three additional single heat sinks and another one and a half tons of armor. The machine guns and ammunition have also been removed from the design and replaced with a single small laser carried in the center torso. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 1K改型特别受栗田家族青睐，虽然它在2603年推出时代表着对凤凰鹰传统思路的偏离。它拆掉机甲上所有跳跃推进器，腾出的空间用于安装三具额外单重散热器和一吨半装甲。机枪及其弹药也从设计中移除，换成中央躯干携带的一门小型激光器。 特质: 改进通讯 投放成本倍率: 1.01

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by House Kurita some time during the Star League Era, this Phoenix Hawk replaces the large laser for an ER large laser and the two medium lasers for medium pulse lasers. To handle the heat load, the 'Mech carries 11 double heat sinks. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一凤凰鹰由栗田家族在星盟时代某时研发，把大型激光器换成增程大型激光器，把两门中型激光器换成中型脉冲激光器。为应对热负荷，该机甲携带11具双重散热器。 特质: 改进通讯 投放成本倍率: 1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A battlefield refit of the PXH-1K, switching the 'Mech to use Double Heat Sinks. The freed up space is used to mount an extra Medium Laser, a C3 slave unit as well as more head protection. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是PXH-1K的战地改装，把机甲改用双重散热器。腾出的空间用于加装一门额外中型激光器、一套C3从属系统以及更多头部防护。 特质: 改进通讯 投放成本倍率: 1.01

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced in 3024, the PXH-1P drops the PXH-1's large laser and the left arm machine guns for an additional center torso medium laser and a left arm–mounted medium hatchet. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: PXH-1P于3024年推出，它拆掉PXH-1的大型激光器和左臂机枪，换成中央躯干一门额外中型激光器和左臂一把中型斧头。 特质: 改进通讯 投放成本倍率: 1.01

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Phoenix Hawk PXH-1R is a basic design brought to the periphery on an export license. It only carries one Large Laser, two Medium Lasers and a single Machine Gun. It does however come with a C3 slave unit. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凤凰鹰PXH-1R是以出口许可带到外缘的基础设计。它只携带一门大型激光器、两门中型激光器和一挺机枪。不过它配有C3从属系统。 特质: 改进通讯 投放成本倍率: 1.01

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Phoenix Hawk PXH-1S, or the 'Hammer Hawk' as often called by its pilots, carries an unusual loadout in form of a mace in its left hand. The right arm mounts a larger laser and a light blazer, allowing consistent damage before the 'Mech has reached close quarters combat to unleash its mace. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凤凰鹰PXH-1S，常被其飞行员称为“锤鹰”，拥有一套不寻常的载荷——左手一把钉头锤。右臂装一门较大激光器和一门轻型聚焦激光，使机甲在进入近距离释放钉头锤之前能持续输出伤害。 特质: 改进通讯 投放成本倍率: 1.01

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Phoenix Hawk PXH-1T was often called the 'Sword Hawk' due its sword carried in the right hand. Besides the melee weapon the variant had a very basic setup, four Medium Lasers and a SRM-6 launcher. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凤凰鹰PXH-1T常被称作“剑鹰”，因为它的右手携带着一把剑。除这件近战武器外，该改型配置非常基础：四门中型激光器和一具SRM-6发射器。 特质: 改进通讯 投放成本倍率: 1.01

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Created by the Golden Star Entertainment conglomerate, the PXH-1VC was a stealth marketing campaign for their newest holovid series. Using an experimental blazer and a salvaged PXH-1D chassis, GSE bankrolled a minor Solaris gladiator in the months before their show launched. A near perfect copy of the ''Gothic'' model used by the shows antagonist, the mech went survived longer than the holovid show; which was cancelled after the 2nd season. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: PXH-1VC由金星娱乐集团创造，是他们为最新全息剧集做的一场隐形营销活动。GSE使用一门实验性聚焦激光和一副打捞来的PHX-1D底盘，在剧集开播前数月资助了一名索拉里斯小角斗士。这台机甲几乎完美复刻了剧中反派使用的“哥特”型号，而且比那部全息剧活得更久——该剧在第二季后被砍。 特质: 改进通讯 投放成本倍率: 1.01

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Based on the PXH-1, this electronic warfare variant introduced in 2599 drops the machine guns and ammunition in favor of a Guardian ECM Suite and another half-ton of armor. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一电子战改型以PXH-1为基础，于2599年推出，拆掉机枪及其弹药，换上一套守卫者ECM套件和另半吨装甲。 特质: 改进通讯 投放成本倍率: 1.01

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Draconis Combine variant carries an ER large laser, a center torso small laser, and an additional medium laser in each side torso. 12 double heat sinks are carried, and eight and a half tons of ferro-fibrous armor provides protection. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一龙尼斯联合体改型携带一门增程大型激光器、中央躯干一门小型激光器，以及两侧躯干各一门额外中型激光器。它携带12具双重散热器，并由八吨半铁纤装甲提供防护。 特质: 改进通讯 投放成本倍率: 1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Phoenix Hawk 2L was one of the first new mechs to be produced under the Long Road initiative. A compete overhaul designed to be compatible with the myriad PXH-1 variants found throughout the Periphery, the redesign takes advantage of Lushan Industries production license for the new ER Large Laser. Mounting this in place of the original Large Laser, the weapons increased heat is balanced by the inclusion of 2 extra heat sinks; with an Endo steel chassis providing the necessary free weight. Retaining the medium lasers and the Guardian ECM suite, the 2L is a cheap upgrade for anyone fielding a PXH-1 design. Available for export throughout the Periphery, the only constraint to production is the lack of a production facility for the PXH chassis, though Alliance Mech Works has plans to build a dedicated PHX line should the design prove popular. Until then the current output is limited to in-situ conversions of existing mechs and the restoration of battlefield salvage. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凤凰鹰2L是“长路”计划下最早投产的新机甲之一。这是一次彻底的重新设计，旨在与外缘各地发现的形形色色的PXH-1改型兼容；它利用了卢尚工业对新型增程大型激光器的生产许可。以它取代原本的大型激光器后，武器增加的热量由2具额外散热器平衡；内层钢底盘提供所需的自由重量。它保留中型激光器和守卫者ECM套件，对任何配备PXH-1设计的人来说都是廉价升级。该型号可供外缘各地出口，生产的唯一制约是缺乏PXH底盘的制造设施，不过联盟机甲厂计划在该设计受欢迎时建造专用的PHX生产线。在那之前，当前产量仅限于对现有机甲的就地改装与战场残骸的修复。 特质: 改进通讯 投放成本倍率: 1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3D variant of this 'Mech was introduced in 3048, based on the 1D used by Davion forces. It was built out of New Avalon by Archenar BattleMechs as one of a slew of redesigns using recovered lostech. The 'Mech utilized Endo Steel construction techniques and a Extra-Light engine to free up weight and space for a number of improvements, particularly its weaponry. The 'Mech carried a pair of ER Large Lasers and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers split between both arms. With the machine guns and their ammunition removed, this allowed two additional heat sinks to be added, and all single heat sinks were exchanged for double strength models. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该机甲的3D改型于3048年推出，以达维昂部队使用的1D为基础。它由阿彻纳尔战斗机甲在新阿瓦隆制造，是一批使用回收失传科技的重新设计之一。该机甲采用内层钢构造技术与一具超轻型引擎，为一系列改进——尤其是武器——腾出重量与空间。它在双臂之间分配了一对增程大型激光器和一对中型脉冲激光器。随着机枪及其弹药被拆除，得以加装两具额外散热器，并且所有单重散热器都换成了双倍强度型号。 特质: 改进通讯 投放成本倍率: 1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3K Phoenix Hawk was another upgrade of the design that used rediscovered technologies, built by Alshain Weapons and GKT Enterprises for House Kurita and the Free Rasalhague Republic respectively. Introduced in 3050, the engine was upgraded to an XL model, with the saved weight used to upgrade the weapons payload on the 'Mech, taking its cues from the 1K variant. Like the PXH-3D model the 3K carries carries two ER large lasers and two medium Lasers. It also carried twelve double heat sinks to manage the additional waste heat, and the eight tons of standard armor were replaced with the same amount of New Samarkand Royal Ferro-Fibrous armor, improving its survivability. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3K凤凰鹰是该设计另一次使用重新发现技术的升级，分别由阿尔沙因武器与GKT企业为栗田家族和自由拉萨尔哈格共和国建造。它于3050年推出，引擎升级为XL型号，省下的重量用于升级机甲的武器载荷，其思路取自1K改型。与PXH-3D型号一样，3K携带两门增程大型激光器和两门中型激光器。它还携带十二具双重散热器以处理额外废热，并把八吨标准装甲换成等量的新萨马尔坎德皇家铁纤装甲，提升其生存力。 特质: 改进通讯 投放成本倍率: 1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3M variant of the 'Mech was also introduced in 3048, built by Earthwerks Incorporated from their Keystone factory and using upgrades based on rediscovered Star League technology. First, the internal structure of the 'Mech has been redesigned to utilize a 1A Type7 Endo Steel chassis. The engine was then replaced with a GM 270 XL and the heat sinks were upgraded to double heat sinks. This allowed the weapons payload to be changed extensively, with all of the original weapons being stripped from the chassis. In their place the 'Mech carried two Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Lasers as its primary weapons and two Martell Medium Pulse Lasers for close in work, with one of each mounted in either arm. Finally, a MainFire Point Defense Anti-Missile System replaced the right-arm machine gun, with two tons of both AMS and machine gun reloads carried in the CASE-protected left torso. The electronic systems were also replaced with an Achernar Electronics HID-8 comm system and Federated Hunter target-tracking system. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该机甲的3M改型同样于3048年推出，由厄斯沃克斯公司在其基斯通工厂建造，升级基于重新发现的星盟科技。首先，机甲的内部结构经过重新设计，采用1A Type7内层钢底盘。随后引擎换成GM 270 XL，散热器升级为双重散热器。这让武器载荷得以大幅变更，原来的武器全部从底盘上剥离。取而代之的是，该机甲以两门迪弗斯光学阳光增程大型激光器为主武器，两门马特尔中型脉冲激光器负责近距离，双臂各装一门。最后，一套主火点防御反导弹系统取代了右臂机枪，AMS与机枪备用弹各两吨装在CASE保护的左躯干中。电子系统也换成阿彻纳尔电子HID-8通讯系统和联邦猎手目标追踪系统。 特质: 改进通讯 投放成本倍率: 1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Refitted on Coordinator Takashi Kurita's order when Shin Yodama was promoted to command the Izanagi Warriors, the basic frame of the Kuroi Kiri mirrored the 3M and was primarily armed with a PPC and ER large laser in its right and left arms respectively. For supporting weaponry, a medium laser is also carried in each arm, along with a left arm–mounted machine gun and right arm–mounted AMS. Fitted with 11 double heat sinks, Shin's 'Mech carries a single ton each of machine gun and AMS ammo in the CASE-protected left torso. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在筱田真被提升为伊邪那奇武士指挥官时，应协调官栗田隆之命进行改装，黑雾的基本框架仿照3M，主要武装为右臂一门PPC和左臂一门增程大型激光器。支援武器方面，双臂各有一门中型激光器，另有左臂一挺机枪和右臂一套AMS。筱田的机甲装11具双重散热器，机枪与AMS弹药各一吨，装在CASE保护的左躯干中。 特质: 改进通讯 投放成本倍率: 1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Piloted by Sir Paul Masters when the Knights of the Inner Sphere were formed, this refit of the 3M version drops one of the large lasers, replacing it with twin SRM-4 launchers and ammunition. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台3M版本的改装由保罗·马斯特斯爵士在内天体骑士团成立时驾驶，它拆掉其中一门大型激光器，换成两具SRM-4发射器及弹药。 特质: 改进通讯 投放成本倍率: 1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3S model of this 'Mech, first deployed in 3042, was another upgrade using rediscovered technology that attempted to make the Phoenix Hawk even more effective for reconnaissance. The engine was upgraded to an ExtraLight version and ten double heat sinks improved heat management. The overall armor protection was increased by one ton and replaced with Lexington Ltd. High Grade Ferro-Fibrous armor. The primary weapon on the 'Mech was a Thunderbolt-12 Large Pulse Laser built into the right arm, though it still retained the two medium lasers and machine guns of the original. Additionally an anti-missile system was mounted on the right arm, with its two tons of ammo (along with two tons of machine gun ammo) protected by CASE in the left torso. Its primary difference from other variants introduced during the time period was the addition of a MASC system, which allowed the 'Mech to reach speeds of up to 129.6 in short bursts. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该机甲的3S型号于3042年首次部署，是另一次使用重新发现技术的升级，试图让凤凰鹰在侦察上更有效。引擎升级为超轻型，十具双重散热器改善了热量管理。整体装甲防护增加一吨，并换成列克星敦有限公司高等级铁纤装甲。该机甲的主武器是装在右臂的一门雷霆-12大型脉冲激光器，不过它仍保留原有的两门中型激光器和机枪。此外右臂装了一套反导弹系统，其两吨弹药（连同两吨机枪弹药）由左躯干的CASE保护。它与同期推出的其他改型的主要区别是加装了一套MASC系统，使机甲能在短时冲刺中达到129.6公里/小时的速度。 特质: 改进通讯 投放成本倍率: 1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Developed by the Clans during the Golden Century, this rebuilt version of the Phoenix Hawk uses an endo steel chassis and XL engine. Nine tons of armor and CASE protect the 'Mech. Each arm carries a medium pulse laser while each side torso carries a UAC/2 with one ton of ammunition for each autocannon. The left torso carries a half ton of machine gun ammunition to feed the machine guns mounted in the head and center torso. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是氏族在黄金世纪研发的凤凰鹰重建版，采用内层钢底盘和XL引擎。九吨装甲和CASE保护该机甲。双臂各携带一门中型脉冲激光器，两侧躯干各携带一门UAC/2，每门自动炮配一吨弹药。左躯干携带半吨机枪弹药，为头部和中央躯干的机枪供弹。 特质: 改进通讯 投放成本倍率: 1.07

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Kobold is a customized variant of the Phoenix Hawk. It features a single large laser and medium laser in the right arm, supported by an SRM-4 and SRM-2 launcher in the left arm in the manner of the Roc and fed from a single ton of reloads, rounded out by a final medium laser in the right torso. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 科博尔德是凤凰鹰的一种定制改型。它在右臂装一门大型激光器和一门中型激光器，左臂以巨鸟的方式配一具SRM-4和一具SRM-2发射器、共用一吨备用弹，最后由右躯干一门中型激光器收尾。 特质: 改进通讯 投放成本倍率: 1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Rifleman II was an upgrade fielded by the SLDF Royals in 2720, adding twenty tons to its overall mass. The Rifleman II used an Endo Steel structure and an XL Engine, and carried a pair of LB-X Autocannon/10s and Large Pulse Lasers, one in each arm, as well as a pair of Medium Lasers, a Beagle Active Probe, and fourteen Double Heat Sinks. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 步枪兵II是SLDF皇家部队于2720年装备的升级版，整体质量增加二十吨。步枪兵II采用内层钢结构和一具XL引擎，携带一对LB-X自动炮/10和大型脉冲激光器（双臂各一门），另有一对中型激光器、一个比格犬主动探测器和十四具双重散热器。 特质: 防空瞄准 投放成本倍率: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another contender for the claim of the infamous gladiator Gray Noton's 'Mech 'Legend-Killer'. As with the other claimants it is not known if this was the actual one or if in fact Noton had several different 'Mechs. This version is an upgraded Rifleman II , which fits with the rumours of Noton bringing back LosTech from the periphery when he returned to conquer the Solaris VII Class Five arenas for seven consecutive years. Quirk: Legend Killer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是声称属于那位臭名昭著的角斗士格雷·诺顿的“传奇杀手”的又一候选者。与其他候选者一样，没人知道这台是不是真品，或者诺顿其实拥有好几台不同的机甲。这一版本是升级版步枪兵II，这与他从外缘带回失传科技、重返索拉里斯VII并连续七年称霸五级竞技场的传闻相符。 特质: 传奇杀手 投放成本倍率: 1.18 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Yet another 'Mech that could possibly be the 'Legend-Killer' piloted by Gray Noton in the Solaris VII arenas. The 'Mech just barely fits the name of the Rifleman, as many parts of the chassis have been replaced from heavier Assault 'Mechs. Quirk: Legend Killer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又一台可能是格雷·诺顿在索拉里斯VII竞技场驾驶的“传奇杀手”的机甲。这台机甲勉强称得上步枪兵这个名字，因为其底盘许多部件已被来自更重的突击机甲的零件替换。 特质: 传奇杀手 投放成本倍率: 1.2 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A heavily rebuilt variant of the RFL-3N claimed to be the infamous 'Mech 'Legend Killer', piloted by the notorious gladiator Noton Gray. By using chassis parts from heavier mechs the tonnage of the RFL-1LK has been increased to 70 ton, allowing it to carry a very deadly arsenal into battle. Quirk: Legend Killer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是号称属于臭名昭著角斗士诺顿·格雷的“传奇杀手”——一台大幅重建的RFL-3N改型。通过使用更重机甲的底盘部件，RFL-1LK的吨位提升到70吨，使其能携带一套极其致命的武库投入战斗。 特质: 传奇杀手 投放成本倍率: 1.12 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The first production version of the Rifleman weighed fifty tons and used primitive technology. Each arm carried a single large laser and medium laser. It was protected by eleven and a half tons of Primitive Armor and used a Primitive Engine to reach a top speed of 64 km/h. Though it served in the Reunification War, this version of the Rifleman was usually used by militia and second line forces thereafter. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.82 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 步枪兵的首个量产版本重五十吨，使用原始技术。双臂各携带一门大型激光器和一门中型激光器。它由十一吨半原始装甲保护，使用一具原始引擎达到64公里/小时的最高速度。虽然它在统一战争中服役，此后这一版本通常由民兵与二线部队使用。 特质: 防空瞄准 投放成本倍率: 0.82 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced in 2556, this version replaced the primitive components with standard armor and engine. The freed space and weight allowed engineers to fit in sixteen heat sinks. The large lasers were removed from the arms and replaced by PPCs, while two more medium lasers were added, one in each side torso. Production of this model continued until the RFL-3N was introduced. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一版本于2556年推出，用标准装甲和引擎取代原始部件。腾出的空间与重量让工程师得以装下十六具散热器。大型激光器从双臂移除、换成PPC，同时新增两门中型激光器，两侧躯干各一门。该型号一直生产到RFL-3N推出。 特质: 防空瞄准 投放成本倍率: 1.02 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A custom variant used by the Wolf Dragoon's that is heavily focused on its offensive capabilities in an attempt to address the shortcomings of its outdated predecessors. Each arm mounts an UAC/5 and a ER Large Laser making it a deadly surprise for any 'Mech warriors unaware of the differences compared to the stock versions. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是狼族龙骑兵使用的定制改型，极度侧重进攻能力，试图弥补其过时前身的缺陷。双臂各装一门UAC/5和一门增程大型激光器，对任何没注意到它与原厂版本差异的机师而言都是致命的惊喜。 特质: 防空瞄准 投放成本倍率: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Rifleman RFL-3B is a strange beast. Its only two weapons are two Binary Lasers, one in each arm, which made it very unwieldy to use in longer engagements due its lack of flexibility to quickly adapt to the ever-changing dynamics of the battlefield. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 步枪兵RFL-3B是个怪东西。它仅有的两件武器是两门二元激光器，双臂各一门，这使它由于缺乏快速适应战场不断变化的灵活性，在持久交战中极难使用。 特质: 防空瞄准 投放成本倍率: 1.06 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The second of two variants designed by Hanse Davion and debuting in 3026, the 3C removes the large lasers and autocannon/5s in order to mount a pair of Autocannon/10s in their place and add an extra ton of armor. Two tons of ammunition for the larger autocannons were carried in the right torso. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是汉斯·达维昂设计的两种改型中的第二种，于3026年首次亮相。3C拆掉大型激光器和自动炮/5，在原地装上一对自动炮/10并增加一吨装甲。这两门更大的自动炮的两吨弹药携带在右躯干。 特质: 防空瞄准 投放成本倍率: 1.06 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A weird all-energy weapons based custom variant that tries to cut back on operating costs by using no ammunition. The increased heat means the 'Mech has to carry 7 external heatsinks, reducing the saved costs by enough to make this a very unpopular version by most. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一种奇特的纯能量武器定制改型，试图通过完全不用弹药来削减运营成本。增加的热量意味着该机甲必须携带7具外置散热器，这抵消了省下的成本，使其成为大多数人眼中非常不受欢迎的版本。 特质: 防空瞄准 投放成本倍率: 1.06 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Custom Kell Hounds variant using looted Clan Large Pulse Lasers and LBX/5 Autocannons to achieve battlefield superiority. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凯尔猎犬的定制改型，使用缴获的氏族大型脉冲激光器和LBX/5自动炮以取得战场优势。 特质: 防空瞄准 投放成本倍率: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Kell Hounds found the stock RFL-3N to be very lacking, replacing most of its weaponry with tech acquired during the company's initial battles with the Clans. The resulting RFL-3N-KH was a lot more deadly, mounting twin Clan UAC/5s with four Clan Extended Range Medium Lasers and two A-Pods as complimentary weaponry. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凯尔猎犬认为原厂RFL-3N非常欠缺，于是把大部分武器换成公司最初与氏族交战期间获得的科技。由此诞生的RFL-3N-KH致命得多，装有两门氏族UAC/5，辅以四门氏族增程中型激光器和两个A吊舱。 特质: 防空瞄准 投放成本倍率: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed as a medium fire-support platform, the Rifleman was plagued with a variety of problems since its debut and was ill-suited as a front-line combatant. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 步枪兵被设计为一种中型火力支援平台，自问世以来却饱受各种问题困扰，也并不适合作为前线战斗单位。 特质: 防空瞄准 投放成本倍率: 1.06 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The RFL-3NR brings just some slight changes to the base RFL-3N design. It replaces the two Medium Lasers with a single Small Laser, but instead adds a C3 slave unit, C.A.S.E protection for the AC/5 ammunition and switches to use Double Heat Sinks. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: RFL-3NR只对基础RFL-3N设计做了些许改动。它把两门中型激光器换成一门小型激光器，但加装了一套C3从属系统、为AC/5弹药加C.A.S.E.防护，并改用双重散热器。 特质: 防空瞄准 投放成本倍率: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan-tech retrofit of the standard Rifleman, the Rifleman C was used by Clan Jade Falcon second-line garrison forces during the invasion. This field modification removed all Inner Sphere weaponry, without altering any structural components of the original RFL-3N, and instead carried two Clan-tech Large Pulse Lasers and LB 5-X ACs split between the arms. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为标准步枪兵的氏族科技改装版，步枪兵C在入侵期间被翡翠猎鹰氏族的二线驻防部队使用。这次战地改装移除了所有内天体武器，却不改动原RFL-3N的任何结构部件，改而在双臂之间装两门氏族科技大型脉冲激光器和LB 5-X AC。 特质: 防空瞄准 投放成本倍率: 1.12 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Long rumored to have piloted a uniquely customized variant, one possible version of Gray Noton's infamous 'Legend-Killer' using only Succession Wars era technology was supposedly built around a lighter 180-rated engine, its lowered ground speed off-set by the inclusion of three jump jets. Offensively this variant reportedly retains the Large Lasers and AC/5s with their single ton ammo bay but drops the Medium Lasers in exchange for four extra heat sinks and a extra half ton of armor. Quirk: Legend Killer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 长期有传言说格雷·诺顿驾驶过一台独特的定制改型，这个只使用继承战争时代技术的可能版本据说围绕一台更轻的180级引擎建造，其降低的地面速度由三个跳跃推进器抵消。进攻方面，据称这一改型保留大型激光器和AC/5及其一吨弹药舱，但拆掉中型激光器，换成四具额外散热器和额外半吨装甲。 特质: 传奇杀手 投放成本倍率: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another possible version of Gray Noton's 'Legend-Killer', this Third Succession War tech level variant retains the 240-rated engine of the RFL-3N but adds four jump jets for enhanced mobility. Their inclusion is made possible by the removal the Large Lasers, moving the torso Medium Lasers into their mounts. Still carrying a single ton of reloads, eleven single heat sinks frees weight for nine and a half tons of armor. Quirk: Legend Killer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是格雷·诺顿“传奇杀手”的另一个可能版本。这一第三次继承战争技术水平改型保留RFL-3N的240级引擎，但加装四个跳跃推进器以增强机动性。它们的加入之所以可能，是因为拆掉了大型激光器，把躯干的中型激光器移到了原位置。它仍携带一吨备用弹，而十一具单重散热器腾出的重量用于九吨半装甲。 特质: 传奇杀手 投放成本倍率: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 4D was one of two variants designed by Hanse Davion; it was intended to compete with the heavier Warhammer. It replaced the autocannon/5s with PPCs and removed the medium lasers, using the freed-up weight to mount an five extra heat sinks. In spite of the extra heat sinks, this model suffered from significant overheat problems. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 4D是汉斯·达维昂设计的两种改型之一，意在对抗更重的重锤。它把自动炮/5换成PPC，并拆掉中型激光器，用腾出的重量安装五具额外散热器。尽管增加了散热器，该型号仍饱受过热问题的困扰。 特质: 防空瞄准 投放成本倍率: 1.06 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 4L was an attempt to make the RFL-4D more useful and increase its survivability. The design replaces the PPCs with a number of Lasers and switches to using double heat sinks. The combination of Endo Steel structure and an XL engine also allowed it to carry several tons more of armor. The variant however underperformed on the battlefield and never reached any success. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 4L是一次让RFL-4D更有用、提升其生存力的尝试。该设计把PPC换成若干激光器，并改用双重散热器。内层钢结构与XL引擎的组合还使它多带了几吨装甲。然而这一改型在战场上表现不佳，从未取得成功。 特质: 防空瞄准 投放成本倍率: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The RFL-4R uses the combination of Endo Steel structure and Ferro-Fibrous armor to free enough weight to increase the armoring significantly while still allowing the use of two LB-X AC/5s. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: RFL-4R利用内层钢结构与铁纤装甲的组合腾出足够重量，大幅增加装甲，同时仍能使用两门LB-X AC/5。 特质: 防空瞄准 投放成本倍率: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan Buster upgrade, the Rifleman 5CS was a Comstar refit designed with the aim of extending the Rifleman’s battlefield endurance. Replacing the original 240-rated Fusion Core with a larger 300-rated XL Engine increased the Mechs speed and allowed for the installation of additional armor. DHS replaced the original SHS, reducing the chronic overheating issues that plagued the Rifleman, while the AC/5’s were upgraded to a pair of UAC/5’s with 2 tons of ammo. The pair of Large Lasers remain, but the 2 Medium Lasers were removed to make space for the UAC ammo. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一款“灭族者”升级，步枪兵5CS是康星的一项改装，旨在延长步枪兵的战场续航力。它把原本的240级聚变核心换成更大的300级XL引擎，提升了机甲速度并得以加装额外装甲。双重散热器取代原单重散热器，缓解了困扰步枪兵的慢性过热问题，而AC/5则升级为两门UAC/5配2吨弹药。两门大型激光器被保留，但2门中型激光器被拆除，为UAC弹药腾出空间。 特质: 防空瞄准 投放成本倍率: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A recovered-technology version of the RFL-4D, the 5D was introduced in 3050 for the Federated Commonwealth. Based on the earlier 4D, it replaces the PPCs with ER PPC models and restores the original model's medium lasers to the side torsos. A 240-rated XL engine was used to free up weight for the mounting of seventeen double heat sinks and an increase in armor protection to nine tons. Production of this model was taken up by Kallon Industries on Talon, Trellshire Industires on Twycross and Red Devil Industries on Pandora. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为RFL-4D的回收技术版本，5D于3050年为联邦共同体推出。它以更早的4D为基础，把PPC换成增程PPC型号，并把原型号的中型激光器恢复到侧躯干。它使用一具240级XL引擎腾出重量，以安装十七具双重散热器并把装甲防护增加到九吨。该型号的生产由塔隆星上的卡隆工业、特威克罗斯星上的特雷尔郡工业和潘多拉星上的红魔工业承担。 特质: 防空瞄准 投放成本倍率: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5M is another product of the Gray Death Memory Core technology boon, built by Kallon Industries at Thermopolis for the Free Worlds League. Introduced in 3049, it retained the same energy weapons as the original 3N but replaced the standard autocannons with Imperator Ultra models; though the ammunition load remained a single ton, it was moved to the right torso and protected by CASE. Twelve double heat sinks were mounted and another ton of Kallon Royalstar armor was carried. The free weight for all these changes was created by the use of an Hermes 240 XL Engine. One thing which wasn't replaced however were the Garret comms and targeting systems. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5M是灰死记忆核心技术红利的又一产物，由卡隆工业在塞莫波利斯为自由世界联盟建造。它于3049年推出，保留与原本3N相同的能量武器，却把标准自动炮换成帝王超速型号；虽然弹药量仍是一吨，但已移到右躯干并由CASE保护。它装有十二具双重散热器，并多带一吨卡隆皇家星装甲。这些改动所需的自由重量来自一具赫尔墨斯240 XL引擎。唯一没有被替换的是加雷特通讯与瞄准系统。 特质: 防空瞄准 投放成本倍率: 1.06 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 'Dao Breaker' is a custom Solaris VII 'Mech configured to carry twin class 5 Autocannons, twin Large Lasers and twin Medium Lasers. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 刀破者是一台索拉里斯VII定制机甲，配置为携带两门5级自动炮、两门大型激光器和两门中型激光器。 特质: 防空瞄准 投放成本倍率: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A prototype further development of the base Rifleman design created by an Inner Sphere design collective a few years before the Clan invasion. The IIA chassis uses its 20 ton increased carry capacity for a combination of long range energy and ballistic weaponry and uses a C3 slave unit to improve the lance performance. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一台在氏族入侵前数年由某个内天体设计团体创造的、对基础步枪兵设计的原型进一步发展型。IIA底盘利用其增加的20吨承载能力，组合远程能量与弹道武器，并使用一套C3从属系统提升分队表现。 特质: 内置探照灯 投放成本倍率: 1.14 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed by the same team as the RFL-IIA, this variant uses a pair of LBX/10 Autocannons, twin ER Large Lasers, two leg mounted LRM-5s and a TAG. It never went beyond early prototype stage, as many of the issues of the original Rifleman was inherited. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一改型由与RFL-IIA相同的团队设计，使用一对LBX/10自动炮、两门增程大型激光器、两具腿部LRM-5和一具TAG。它从未走出早期原型阶段，因为继承了原版步枪兵的许多问题。 特质: 内置探照灯 投放成本倍率: 1.14 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The predecessor to the original Flea FLE-4 model, the Trooper TP-1R prototype was built in 2475, by Toddlette Industries, on a primitive chassis and maintained ground speeds of nearly 100 km/h. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.75 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为原版跳蚤FLE-4的前身，士兵TP-1R原型于2475年由托德莱特工业在原始底盘上建造，保持接近100公里/小时的地面速度。 特质: 改进生命维持 投放成本倍率: 0.75 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Vulcan VL-2T-CE uses Clan Early technology weapons to improve the original designs performance. By replacing the standard AC/2 with an Improved AC/2, the suddenly spare ton of weight capacity was used to replace the Machine Gun with a Dual linked setup and the addition of a Small Laser. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火神VL-2T-CE使用氏族早期技术武器提升原设计的性能。它把标准AC/2换成改进型AC/2，突然多出的一吨承载能力用于把机枪换成双联配置，并加装一门小型激光器。 特质: 狭小/低矮外形 投放成本倍率: 1.01 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Vulcan is lightly armored at only five tons, though this is typically sufficient when facing infantry forces and its narrow profile makes it a harder target to hit. A cruising speed of 64.8 km/h is enhanced with by six jump jets mounted in the rear of the Vulcan's torso, specially vented to reduce heat build-up in the rear, giving it a jumping range of 180 meters. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火神的装甲很薄，只有五吨，不过面对步兵部队时通常够用，且其狭窄的轮廓使其更难被命中。64.8公里/小时的巡航速度由装在火神躯干后部的六个跳跃推进器增强——它们经过特别通风以减少后部积热——使其跳跃距离达180米。 特质: 狭小/低矮外形 投放成本倍率: 1 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The VL-2TR replaces the Flamer in the Right Arm and the external Heat Sink with a C3 slave unit in the head, increasing the Vulcans in-lance performance. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: VL-2TR把右臂的火焰喷射器和外置散热器换成头部的C3从属系统，提升了火神在分队内的表现。 特质: 狭小/低矮外形 投放成本倍率: 1 手臂驱动器限制: 左下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Piloted by Richard Timms of the 3rd Davion Guards during the failed attack on Vega during the War of 3039. The Machine Guns, ammo and Medium Laser were replaced with two additional Flamers and a Small laser. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台机甲由达维昂第三卫队的理查德·蒂姆斯在3039年战争中对维加的那次失败进攻中驾驶。它的机枪、弹药和中型激光器被换成两具额外火焰喷射器和一门小型激光器。 特质: 狭小/低矮外形 投放成本倍率: 1.02 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the most common of the Vulcan's early variants, the 5T was introduced a year after the original model debuted. It removes the Autocannon/2 and replaces it with three Maxum medium lasers, using the mass saved to add two additional tons of armor. The majority of the Federated Suns' Vulcans were 5T models. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为火神早期改型中最常见的一种，5T在原型号亮相一年后推出。它拆掉自动炮/2，换成三门马克西姆中型激光器，用省下的质量增加两吨装甲。联邦太阳的大多数火神都是5T型号。 特质: 狭小/低矮外形 投放成本倍率: 1 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bloodlust is a custom Vulcan variant. Weaponry consists of two Machine Guns in the Left Arm, while a Small Laser and another Machine Gun round out the Right Arm. The Head, Right and Left Torso each carry an SRM-4, while four tons of ammo help keep the SRM's sufficiently supplied. Like all the current variants of the Canon versions, the Bloodlust is jump capable, however, has Standard Heat Sink capability. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 嗜血是火神的一种定制改型。其武器包括左臂两挺机枪，右臂则是一门小型激光器和另一挺机枪。头部、左右躯干各携带一具SRM-4，另有四吨弹药确保SRM补给充足。与当前所有正典版本改型一样，嗜血具备跳跃能力，但使用标准散热器。 特质: 狭小/低矮外形 投放成本倍率: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5M Vulcan is an upgrade of the 2T version used by House Marik that makes the 'Mech far more effective in close range combat. The 'Mech uses a Crucis-II Delux Endo Steel chassis and removes the autocannon for a Tronel PPL-20 Large Pulse Laser and also upgrades the Medium Laser to a Tronel XII Medium Pulse Laser. Eleven double heat sinks were also incorporated. This version of the Vulcan began production in 3052 and ceased only with the destruction of Nimakachi's Tematagi plant in 3069. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5M火神是马里克家族使用的2T版本的升级，使机甲在近距离作战中有效得多。该机甲采用克鲁西斯-II豪华内层钢底盘，拆掉自动炮换成一门特罗内尔PPL-20大型脉冲激光器，并把中型激光器升级为特罗内尔XII中型脉冲激光器。它还加入了十一具双重散热器。这一版火神于3052年开始生产，直到3069年尼玛卡奇的特马塔吉工厂被摧毁才停产。 特质: 狭小/低矮外形 投放成本倍率: 1.02 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5S Vulcan is a 3050 upgrade of the 2T version used by House Steiner which replaces the standard fusion engine with an extralight engine and also upgrades the armor to Lexington Ltd. High Grade Ferro-Fibrous with CASE to protect itself from ammunition explosions. The inclusion of MASC enables the 5S to move up to 129 km/h in short bursts. Additionally, the Autocannon/2 has been replaced with an Imperator Ultra Autocannon/5. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5S火神是斯坦纳家族使用的2T版本的3050年升级，它把标准聚变引擎换成超轻型引擎，并把装甲升级为列克星敦有限公司高等级铁纤，辅以CASE以防弹药爆炸。MASC的加入使5S能在短时冲刺中跑到129公里/小时。此外，自动炮/2被换成了一门帝王超速自动炮/5。 特质: 狭小/低矮外形 投放成本倍率: 1.02 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A further update of the -5T, the -6M uses Endo-Steel structure and an XL engine, drops half a ton of the Machine Gun ammunition and switches to Double Heatsinks. As a result the variant is able to replace the Lasers with 4 Medium Pulse Lasers, add a C3 slave unit, increase the amount of armor, upgrade the rating of the engine core to 280 and add an extra Jump Jet. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为-5T的进一步更新，-6M采用内层钢结构和一具XL引擎，去掉半吨机枪弹药并改用双重散热器。因此该改型得以把激光器换成4门中型脉冲激光器、加装一套C3从属系统、增加装甲量、把引擎核心等级升级到280并加装一个额外跳跃推进器。 特质: 狭小/低矮外形 投放成本倍率: 1.02 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Wolfman was first created by Valdis Ullman, a MechWarrior belonging to the Legion of Vega, on Bergman's Planet during the Second Battle of Ryersson in 2986. Originally piloting a Wolverine, his BattleMech was damaged in a fight with a Davion Marauder, with most of its upper body damaged or destroyed. Fortunately, a Davion Rifleman had been destroyed only a hundred meters away from his 'Mech. The Rifleman had suffered damage to its torso and legs. Ullman's personal technician, Sharis Brand thought that the two 'Mechs could be merged together, taking the intact legs and hips from Ullman's Wolverine and combining it with the torso and arms from the Rifleman. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狼人最初由维加军团机师瓦尔迪斯·乌尔曼于2986年第二次赖尔森战役期间在伯格曼行星创造。他原本驾驶一台狼獾，其机甲在与一台达维昂掠夺者的交战中受损，上半身大部分被损坏或摧毁。幸运的是，一台达维昂步枪兵就在他的机甲一百米外被摧毁。那台步枪兵躯干与双腿受损。乌尔曼的私人技师莎丽丝·布兰德认为两台机甲可以合并——把乌尔曼狼獾完好的双腿与髋部取下，与步枪兵的躯干和双臂组合。 特质: 无处不在 投放成本倍率: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Whoever this "Jonathon" was, he had access to some very high-tech equipment. A pair of Enhanced LRM-20 Artemis launchers are backed up by a handheld "Avenger Rifle", which is some kind of hand-held RAC/5 comparable to the best RISC technology. Maybe it would be more appropriate to call that thing the primary weapon, as it carries more than twice as much ammo as the meager three tons of missiles. This is all wrapped in a thick shell of top-of-the-line mimetic stealth armor. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 不管这位“乔纳森”是谁，他都能接触到一些非常高科技的装备。一对增强型LRM-20阿尔忒弥斯发射器由一支手持“复仇者步枪”提供后援——那是某种手持式RAC/5，性能堪比最好的RISC技术。也许把那东西称为主武器更合适，因为它携带的弹药是那可怜的三吨导弹的两倍多。这一切都包裹在一层顶级拟态隐形装甲的厚壳里。 特质: 指挥机甲 投放成本倍率: 1.06

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A first generation BattleMech, the 50 ton Phoenix was the first native BattleMech to be built by the Rim Worlds Republic. Powered by a 250-rated Fusion Core, the Phoenix 3R carried a PPC and a pair of SRM-2’s. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为第一代战斗机甲，50吨的凤凰是边缘世界共和国建造的第一种本土战斗机甲。它由一具250级聚变核心驱动，凤凰3R携带一门PPC和两具SRM-2。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制: 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Whoever this "Jonathon" was, he had access to some very high-tech equipment. A pair of Enhanced LRM-20 Artemis launchers are backed up by a handheld "Avenger Rifle", which is some kind of hand-held RAC/5 comparable to the best RISC technology. Maybe it would be more appropriate to call that thing the primary weapon, as it carries more than twice as much ammo as the meager three tons of missiles. This is all wrapped in a thick shell of top-of-the-line mimetic stealth armor. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 不管这位“乔纳森”是谁，他都能接触到一些非常高科技的装备。一对增强型LRM-20阿尔忒弥斯发射器由一支手持“复仇者步枪”提供后援——那是某种手持式RAC/5，性能堪比最好的RISC技术。也许把那东西称为主武器更合适，因为它携带的弹药是那可怜的三吨导弹的两倍多。这一切都包裹在一层顶级拟态隐形装甲的厚壳里。 特质: 指挥机甲 投放成本倍率: 1.06

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A first generation BattleMech, the 50 ton Phoenix was the first native BattleMech to be built by the Rim Worlds Republic. Powered by a 250-rated Fusion Core, the Phoenix 3R carried a PPC and a pair of SRM-2’s. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为第一代战斗机甲，50吨的凤凰是边缘世界共和国建造的第一种本土战斗机甲。它由一具250级聚变核心驱动，凤凰3R携带一门PPC和两具SRM-2。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制: 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally developed in the final year of the Amaris Civil War as the ultimate fixed position city defense BattleMech, the Annihilator was built as a sign of the military strength of the Star League in Exile. The -1A was armed with four Autocannon/10s and four Medium Lasers. While less accurate than the original -2A, the 1A was still a highly destructive and dangerous 'Mech that no MechWarrior looked forward to engaging. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 歼灭者最初在阿马里斯内战的最后一年作为终极固定阵地城市防御战斗机甲研发，被打造为流亡星盟军事实力的象征。-1A武装为四门自动炮/10和四门中型激光器。虽然不如最初的-2A精准，1A仍是一台破坏力极强、极度危险的机甲，没有机师愿意与它交战。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Still a fearsome and powerful design, where the original Annihilator-1A carries a bevy of powerful autocannons, the -1E instead opts for an all-energy weapon loadout. Four Particle Projection Cannons give the Annihilator-1E a brutal and incredibly powerful punch while the Medium Lasers from the -1A are carried over for in-close protection while increasing the armor protection somewhat to mitigate enemy return fire. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这仍是一个令人生畏、威力强大的设计：原本的歼灭者-1A携带着一批强力自动炮，而-1E改而选择全能量武器载荷。四门粒子投射炮赋予歼灭者-1E残暴而难以置信的打击力，同时继承了-1A的中型激光器用于近距离自卫，并略微增加装甲防护以减轻敌方回击。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant had an ER PPC in the right torso, and three Gauss Rifles (one in each arm, and one in the left torso) to provide hard hitting firepower. Each Gauss Rifle had two tons of ammunition. Ten double heat sinks were more than adequate to keep the machine cool. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一改型右躯干装一门增程PPC，另有三门磁轨炮（双臂各一门，左躯干一门）提供沉重打击火力。每门磁轨炮配两吨弹药。十具双重散热器足以让这台机器保持凉爽。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original model created in 2779 was equipped with a head-mounted Small Laser, four LB 10-X AC, a pair of Small Pulse Lasers, and four Medium Lasers. It carried six tons of LB 10-X ammunition, and the torsos were protected with CASE. Ten double heat sinks kept heat manageable. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初于2779年创造的型号装备头部一门小型激光器、四门LB 10-X AC、一对小型脉冲激光器和四门中型激光器。它携带六吨LB 10-X弹药，躯干以CASE保护。十具双重散热器将热量控制在可管理范围。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally developed in the final year of the Amaris Civil War as the ultimate fixed position city defense BattleMech, the Annihilator was built as a sign of the military strength of both the Star League in Exile and the newly created Clans. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 歼灭者最初在阿马里斯内战的最后一年作为终极固定阵地城市防御战斗机甲研发，被打造为流亡星盟与新生氏族双方军事实力的象征。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.18 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An upgrade of 'acquired' ANH-1X variant 'Mechs from Clans storage as they were phased out due to their inferior design. The main goal of the update was increasing its mobility through a 300-rated XL engine. While the design managed to keep the four LBX AC/10 and Medium Lasers, to be able to carry the engine both the C.A.S.E. protection and the small lasers had to be dropped. However, a C3 Slave unit was added in the 'Mechs head. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是对从氏族库存中“获得”的ANH-1X改型机甲的一次升级——它们因设计低劣而被逐步淘汰。升级的主要目标是通过一具300级XL引擎提升其机动性。该设计设法保留了四门LBX AC/10和中型激光器，但为了装下这台引擎，必须去掉C.A.S.E.防护和小型激光器。不过，机甲头部加装了一套C3从属系统。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.18 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The ANH-4W is a Wolf Dragoon's upgrade performed on some of the Annihilators they managed to 'free' from the clans control. These Annihilators were upgraded with a 200 XL clan engine and switched to clan double heat sinks. The weaponry was exchanged with a highly unusual mix of Ultra and LBX autocannons, since this is what was in surplus at the time. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: ANH-4W是狼族龙骑兵对他们设法从氏族控制下“解放”的部分歼灭者所做的升级。这些歼灭者换装了一台200 XL氏族引擎，并改用氏族双重散热器。武器被换成一种极不寻常的超速与LBX自动炮混合配置，因为当时手上富余的就是这些。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.24 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A variant of the Annihilator that was built using only Clan technology and used exclusively by the Wolf's Dragoons, the Annihilator C increased its maximum speed to 54 km/h. The 'Mech was armed with four Ultra Autocannon/10s and four ER Medium Lasers. The Ultra Autocannon/10s allowed the 'Mech to fire at twice the rate of a normal autocannon, allowing it to put as much fire out as if it was carrying eight regular autocannons. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为仅使用氏族科技建造、且由狼族龙骑兵独家使用的歼灭者改型，歼灭者C把最高速度提升到54公里/小时。该机甲武装为四门超速自动炮/10和四门增程中型激光器。超速自动炮/10让该机甲能以普通自动炮两倍的射速开火，使其火力输出相当于携带八门常规自动炮。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.22 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Apparently based on the ANH-1G, this variant only uses Clan technology. The 'Mech's top speed was 32.4 km/h and the armor protection was reduced, but four Gauss Rifles backed up by an ER PPC in the center torso and a head mounted ER Small Laser provided withering firepower for defensive engagements. Ten tons of ammunition kept the Gauss Rifles fed through the longest engagements. To make room for all these weapons, the C2 used an Endo Steel internal structure. Integrated CASE protected the arms and torsos from Gauss Rifle explosions. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一改型显然以ANH-1G为基础，只使用氏族科技。该机甲最高速度32.4公里/小时，装甲防护有所减少，但四门磁轨炮配以中央躯干的一门增程PPC和头部一门增程小型激光器，为防御作战提供了摧枯拉朽的火力。十吨弹药让磁轨炮能撑过最漫长的交战。为容纳这些武器，C2采用了内层钢内部结构。整合式CASE保护双臂与躯干免受磁轨炮爆炸之害。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.22 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Designed as a joke, the "Gausszilla" was never intended for production, let alone deployment. Nobody is quite sure who submitted the design file titled "Gausszilla_Meme_Final_NOTFINAL_DONOTUSE_v3.mtf" to the factory. Stranger still is that it was greenlit. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Gauss Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为玩笑设计的“磁轨炮哥斯拉”从未打算投产，更不用说部署。没人十分确定是谁把那份名为“Gausszilla_Meme_Final_NOTFINAL_DONOTUSE_v3.mtf”的设计文件提交给工厂的。更奇怪的是它居然被批准了。 特质: 精准武器 - 磁轨炮 投放成本倍率: 1.2 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Apparently based on the Annihilator C 2, this customized variant of the chassis carries five Clan Gauss rifles. It was thought lost to history. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Gauss Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这台定制改型的底盘显然以歼灭者C 2 为基础，装有五门氏族磁轨炮。它一度被认为已湮没于历史。 特质: 精准武器 - 磁轨炮 投放成本倍率: 1.24 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A custom battlefield refit of the ANH-3A1 that gained some popularity, as trading the C3 slave unit for putting the CASE protection back in was well worth it to many 'MechWarriors that had the choice. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是ANH-3A1的一次战地定制改装，并颇受欢迎——对许多有得选的机师来说，用C3从属系统换回CASE防护非常值得。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.18 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally developed in the final year of the Amaris Civil War as the ultimate fixed position city defense BattleMech, the Annihilator was built as a sign of the military strength of both the Star League in Exile and the newly created Clans. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 歼灭者最初在阿马里斯内战的最后一年作为终极固定阵地城市防御战斗机甲研发，被打造为流亡星盟与新生氏族双方军事实力的象征。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1.24 手臂驱动器限制: 左下, 右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A contemporary of 'Mechs such as the Thunderbolt and the Banshee, the Archer's primary role was fire support Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.88
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为雷霆与女妖等机甲的同时代产物，弓箭手的主要角色是火力支援 特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 0.88

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A jump-enabled version of the -2R, the -2J fits four jump jets at the cost of replacing two the LRM-20 launchers with its smaller kin, the LRM-15 launcher. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -2R的跳跃改型，-2J装四个跳跃推进器，代价是把两具LRM-20发射器换成了更小的同类——LRM-15发射器。 特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.08

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 2K Archer was a modification built for House Kurita in 2856, designed to increase its direct firepower capability and give it more staying power on the battlefield once it had run out of ammunition Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2K弓箭手是2856年为栗田家族建造的改装，旨在提升其直射火力，并让它在弹药耗尽后仍能在战场上撑得更久 特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.08

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced in 3026, the 2P is rebuilt for short-range and melee combat, retaining only the left and center-torso medium lasers of the ARC-2R, dropping the LRM racks to carry an SRM-4 and SRM-6 rack in each side torso, freeing up the weight for a heavy longsword carried in the right arm. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2P于3026年推出，为近距离与近战重建，只保留ARC-2R的左侧与中央躯干中型激光器，拆掉LRM架，改为每侧躯干各装一具SRM-4和SRM-6架，省出的重量用于在右臂携带一把重型长剑。 特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.08

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A contemporary of 'Mechs such as the Thunderbolt and the Banshee, the Archer's primary role was fire support Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为雷霆与女妖等机甲的同时代产物，弓箭手的主要角色是火力支援 特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.08

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 2Rb variant of the Archer was built for SLDF Royal units starting in 2752. A contemporary of 'Mechs such as the Thunderbolt and the Banshee, the Archer's primary role was fire support. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 弓箭手的2Rb改型从2752年起为SLDF皇家部队建造。作为雷霆与女妖等机甲的同时代产物，弓箭手的主要角色是火力支援。 特质: 指挥机甲 投放成本倍率: 1.1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A battlefield refit of the -2R, replacing the two Center Torso-mounted Medium Lasers with C.A.S.E. system side torso protection and a C3 slave unit. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是-2R的战地改装，把中央躯干的两门中型激光器换成C.A.S.E.系统侧躯干防护和一套C3从属系统。 特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.08

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A clan partial refit of the original -2R, replacing all the weapons with the improved clan versions allowing more LRM launchers to be added. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是对原本-2R的氏族部分改装，把所有武器换成改进后的氏族版本，从而得以加装更多LRM发射器。 特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.08

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Personal 'Mech of Kell Hounds commander Morgan Kell, during the Clan Invasion he had his stock ARC-2R model upgraded with recovered Star League and salvaged Clan systems. Using Clan-grade LRM-20s and Double Heat Sinks freed up weight for more armor, more LRM ammunition, Artemis IV, CASE and a Clan Active Probe in the head to enhance it's command abilities. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是凯尔猎犬指挥官摩根·凯尔的私人机甲，氏族入侵期间他把自己原厂的ARC-2R升级为回收的星盟系统与打捞来的氏族系统。使用氏族级LRM-20和双重散热器省出重量用于更多装甲、更多LRM弹药、阿尔忒弥斯IV、CASE以及头部的氏族主动探测器，以增强其指挥能力。 特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.12

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the personal 'Mechs used by Colonel Marco Rubinsky, the leader of the mercenary band Rubinsky’s Light Horse. Focused mainly on the defense off himself from ambushes and assassination attempts, the Mech replaces the long range capabilities of the LRM launchers with SRM ones and carries a hatchet. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是雇佣兵团体鲁宾斯基轻骑兵首领马可·鲁宾斯基上校使用的私人机甲之一。它主要着眼于保护自己免遭伏击与刺杀，把LRM发射器的远程能力换成SRM，并携带一把斧头。 特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A another modification made to allow the Archer to defend itself more easily against an enemy that managed to close range with it. Built for House Steiner in 2915 Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是为了让弓箭手更容易抵御逼近的敌人而做的另一项改装。2915年为斯坦纳家族建造 特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.08

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Carrying a pair of SRM-4s in place of two medium lasers, this was the trademark variant used by the Wolf's Dragoons, which they produced in the assembly plant aboard their space station Hephaestos until its destruction in 3028. It was once stated by Jaime Wolf that all of the Dragoons' Archers were of this variant. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它以两具SRM-4取代两门中型激光器，是狼族龙骑兵的标志性改型，他们曾在其太空站赫菲斯托斯上的装配厂生产该型号，直到该厂于3028年被摧毁。海梅·沃夫曾说过，龙骑兵所有的弓箭手都是这个改型。 特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.08

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 4M variant of the Archer was built using rediscovered Star League technology. A contemporary of 'Mechs such as the Thunderbolt and the Banshee, the Archer's primary role was fire support Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 弓箭手的4M改型采用重新发现的星盟科技建造。作为雷霆与女妖等机甲的同时代产物，弓箭手的主要角色是火力支援 特质: 指挥机甲 投放成本倍率: 1.1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Personal 'Mech of Lieutenant James Ismail of the Lexington Combat Group's 180th Dragoon Combat Group has been refit for close combat. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是列克星敦战斗群第一八〇龙骑兵战斗群詹姆斯·伊斯梅尔中尉的私人机甲，已为近战改装。 特质: 指挥机甲 投放成本倍率: 1.1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan Buster upgrade, the Archer 5CS was a Comstar prototype rushed into production specifically to outfit units that would be fighting on Tukayyid. Designed to carry as much firepower as possible, a combination of a 280-rated XL Engine, Endo Steel chassis and DHS free up the tonnage need to mount 4 LRM-15’s with an Artemis IV FCS. A pair of Medium Lasers are retained should enemies close on the Archer. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一款“灭族者”升级，弓箭手5CS是康星的原型，专门赶工投产，用以装备将在图卡伊德作战的部队。它以尽可能多的火力为设计目标，280级XL引擎、内层钢底盘与双重散热器的组合腾出了安装4具LRM-15（带阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统）所需的吨位。若敌人逼近，它还保留了一对中型激光器。 特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -5KH is a clan tech refit of the -5R chassis by the mercenary outfit the Kell Hounds with the goal of strengthening it's long-range capabilities by mounting two LRM-20 as its main weaponry. The addition of four medium lasers give some closer range protection, and more armor plating has been added to improve the battlefield endurance. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -5KH是雇佣兵部队凯尔猎犬对-5R底盘所做的氏族科技改装，目标是通过装两具LRM-20作为主武器来强化其远程能力。新增的四门中型激光器提供一些近距离防护，另加装了更多装甲板以提升战场续航力。 特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.16

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built by the GKT Enterprise factory on Satalice for the Free Rasalhague Republic, the 5R was introduced in 3050 and bore similarities to the 2K model of the Archer. It carried a pair of FarFire LRM-15 launchers but mounted two Victory Nickel Alloy ER Large Lasers, one in either arm, in place of the medium lasers. It also linked Artemis IV fire control systems to the launchers and utilized twelve double heat sinks to improve waste heat dissipation. Despite being built around an Endo-Steel chassis, these improvements necessitated a decrease in armor protection by two tons. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为自由拉萨尔哈格共和国建造，5R由萨塔利斯上的GKT企业工厂生产，于3050年推出，与弓箭手的2K型号有相似之处。它携带两具法火LRM-15发射器，却以两门胜利镍合金增程大型激光器（双臂各一门）取代中型激光器。它还为发射器接上了阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统，并使用十二具双重散热器以改善废热散发。尽管以内层钢底盘建造，这些改进仍迫使装甲防护减少两吨。 特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5S variant of the Archer, built out of Defiance Industries' massive Hesperus II complex in 3050, was the official variant for the Armed Forces of the Federated Commonwealth. The 5S upgraded the engine to an Edasich Motors 280 XL Engine, cutting the engine's weight in half while retaining the same speed profile. The 5S also reduced the LRM-20 launchers to LRM-15s. This saved weight was used to add two Coventry T4H Streak SRM-2 launchers, one in each arm and fed by two tons of reloads in the side torsos. They also upgraded the four medium lasers to Medium Pulse Lasers. Finally, the 'Mech carried a Doering Electronics Glowworm Narc Missile Beacon launcher in its left torso along with one ton of ammo. This allowed the Archer to tag enemy units with a beacon so that friendly 'Mechs could more easily hit the unit with their own missile weapons. All of the ammunition carried by the 5S was protected by CASE. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 弓箭手的5S改型于3050年由反抗工业庞大的赫斯佩鲁斯II厂区产出，是联邦太阳武装部队的官方改型。5S把引擎升级为一台埃达西奇动力280 XL引擎，在保持相同速度表现的同时把引擎重量减半。5S还把LRM-20发射器缩减为LRM-15。省出的重量用于加装两具考文垂T4H连发SRM-2发射器，双臂各一，由侧躯干的两吨备用弹供弹。他们还把四门中型激光器升级为中型脉冲激光器。最后，该机甲在左躯干携带一具多林电子萤火虫Narc导弹信标发射器配一吨弹药。这让弓箭手能用信标标记敌方单位，使友军机甲更容易用自己的导弹武器命中该单位。5S携带的所有弹药都由CASE保护。 特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 5W was an upgrade of the 2W variant, and was produced for the Wolf's Dragoons by Bowie Industries at Alarion. This was done in an orbital 'Mech repair facility which was converted into a 'Mech assembly line. Introduced in 3050, the 'Mech was upgraded with an XL Engine to save weight and used ten double heat sinks for greater heat dissipation. It retained the two LRM-20 launchers but replaced all other weaponry with one TharHes Blue SRM-4 launchers in each arm and a Doering Electronics Glowworm Narc Missile Beacon launcher in the center torso. The 5W was supplied with four tons of LRM reloads, two tons of SRM reloads, and two tons of Narc reloads, all carried in the CASE-protected side torsos. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -5WDR is a mercenary full clan tech refit of the -5R initially introduced by the Wolf's Dragoons. Using an XL clan engine allows the mounting of four Artemis IV-enabled LRM-15 launchers and four ER Medium Lasers, combined with two Small Pulse Lasers for close range, leading to high damage capabilities. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -5WDR是雇佣兵对-5R的全氏族科技改装，最初由狼族龙骑兵推出。使用氏族XL引擎使机甲得以装下四具带阿尔忒弥斯IV的LRM-15发射器和四门增程中型激光器，再加两门小型脉冲激光器用于近距离，带来极高的伤害能力。 特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.16

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Rather than a refit of the -6S or the -6W, the -6WDR is actually a refresh of the -5WDR by the mercenary outfit the Wolf's Dragoons. Removing the two seldom used Small Pulse Lasers allows the use of an Armored Cowl and one more heat sink. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: -6WDR并非对-6S或-6W的改装，实际上它是雇佣兵部队狼族龙骑兵对-5WDR的翻新版。拆除两门很少使用的小型脉冲激光器，得以使用一顶装甲罩壳和额外一具散热器。 特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Archer 8L is a prototype chassis designed to provide fire support with 2 Arrow IV Launchers loaded with Incendiary Missiles and the newly developed Guardian ECM and Stealth Armor. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 弓箭手8L是一种原型底盘，旨在以2具装填燃烧弹的箭矢IV发射器，加上新研发的守卫者ECM与隐形装甲，提供火力支援。 特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.12

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Agincourt is armed with a medium laser and a SRM-6 in each arm with two tons of ammo for the SRM-6's, A Streak SRM-2 and a LRM-10 are equipped in each side torso with two ton of reloads for the Streak SRM-2's and two tons of reloads for the LRM-10's, a Beagle Active Probe is additionally mounted in the left torso, two Medium Pulse Lasers are mounted in the center torso, and fourteen double heat sinks keep the 'Mech cool. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿金库尔双臂各装一门中型激光器和一具SRM-6，并为SRM-6配两吨弹药；两侧躯干各装一具连发SRM-2和一具LRM-10，连发SRM-2与LRM-10各配两吨备用弹；左躯干另装一个比格犬主动探测器，中央躯干装两门中型脉冲激光器，十四具双重散热器让机甲保持凉爽。 特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.12

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A contemporary of 'Mechs such as the Thunderbolt and the Banshee, the Archer's primary role was fire support. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为雷霆与女妖等机甲的同时代产物，弓箭手的主要角色是火力支援。 特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.08

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Named for Morgan Kell's pirate lover, the -2T Tempest is identical to the standard ARC-2R in most respects. The use of an Endo Steel frame frees up the weight for a Guardian ECM suite and two extra heat sinks, all of which are upgraded to double heat sinks boosting the Tempest's endurance. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 以摩根·凯尔的海盗情人命名，-2T暴风在大多数方面与标准ARC-2R相同。采用内层钢框架省出的重量用于一套守卫者ECM套件和两具额外散热器，所有散热器都升级为双重散热器，提升了暴风的续航力。 特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.12

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This variant of the Archer carried Clan-spec equipment. The arms mounted ER Large Lasers, while a pair of Small Pulse Lasers covered the rear. The LRM-20s were enhanced with Artemis IV Fire Control Systems, and an ECM Suite and AMS protected against incoming fire. Fifteen double heat sinks kept the 'Mech cool. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 弓箭手的这一改型携带氏族规格装备。双臂装增程大型激光器，一对小型脉冲激光器掩护后方。LRM-20由阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统增强，另有一套ECM套件和AMS防御来袭火力。十五具双重散热器让机甲保持凉爽。 特质: 指挥机甲 投放成本倍率: 1.18

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A clan update of the Archer rarely seen due to not performing as well as expected. The philosophy of the design is to create the optimal support heavy for indirect fire, mounting four Artemis IV-enabled LRM-20 launchers. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是弓箭手的一种氏族升级版，因表现不如预期而罕见。该设计的理念是打造最优的间接火力重型支援机甲，装有四具带阿尔忒弥斯IV的LRM-20发射器。 特质: 战斗拳 投放成本倍率: 1.14

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Keeping the top speed of the ASN-21 as well as its base weapon load of missiles, the ASN-101 is a rare Federated Suns variant that drops two jump jets and a half ton of armor to mount a trio of Small Lasers, giving the ASN-101 a much better close-in punch compared to its progenitor. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: ASN-101保留了ASN-21的最高速度及其以导弹为基础的基础武器载荷，是联邦太阳的一种稀有改型。它拆掉两个跳跃推进器和半吨装甲，以安装三兄弟小型激光器，使其相比前身拥有好得多的近距离打击力。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1 手臂驱动器限制: 右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Assassin was designed to complete against the lighter scout mechs like the Wasp and Stinger but is twice as heavy, faster, greater jump range, heavier armor and much more firepower. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 刺客的设计初衷是与黄蜂、毒刺这类更轻的侦察机甲竞争，但它的重量是它们的两倍，速度更快、跳跃距离更远、装甲更厚、火力也强得多。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1 手臂驱动器限制: 右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The -23 variant of the Assassin is an upgrade of the original model using Lostech; originally seen as a standardized field modification, in 3067 new production began at Hellespont 'Mech Works. The SRM-2 has been removed to upgrade the Medium Laser to a Medium Pulse Laser and an Artemis IV fire control system has been added for the LRM-5 launcher. Within the CCAF, TDF and MAF it is largely used as a cheap way to rebuild shattered forces and sees service mostly in green and reserve formations. The Capellans in particular use the -23 as a fire-support unit for pursuit and strike lances, though shortages of Artemis munitions means many are forced to use mine-delivery missiles. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduced in 3026 to tap into the rise of interest in melee weapons, the ASN-25 retains the right arm's medium laser, but replaces the remaining weaponry with a right torso-mounted medium laser and left torso-mounted small laser, the weight saved to mount a medium claw in the left arm. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: ASN-25于3026年推出，以迎合近战武器兴趣的兴起，它保留右臂的中型激光器，但把其余武器换成右躯干一门中型激光器和左躯干一门小型激光器，省出的重量用于在左臂装一只中型爪。 特质: 易于维护 投放成本倍率: 1 手臂驱动器限制: 右下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A 3050's tech version of the -30, the -26 also uses an endo steel chassis but mounts an XL engine, the extra weight saved allowing the 'Mech to carry an UAC/5 and a pair of medium pulse lasers for offensive armament. Field endurance is limited however, as six and half tons of armor provided basic protection, and a single ton of autocannon reloads are chewed through rapidly. The 10 double heat sinks struggle to manage heat strain. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A 3050 era take on -99, the -27 drops the sword to upgrade the light PPC to a full size PPC thanks to the use of endo steel, retaining the Guardian ECM suite but replacing the stealth armor with an equal volume of standard armor. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

Retaining the ASN-21's seven jump jets, that variant's single heat sinks are also upgraded to double strength versions. Though carrying only a single ton of autocannon and LRM reloads limits it field endurance, DarkDeath mounts a Guardian ECM suite to help ensure the fight is on its terms. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

The difficulty in sourcing parts and the hand built nature of each Bullshark would limit it to a mere 2 dozen examples, most of which served with the Magistracy Armed Forces. The unveiling of the Helm Core and subsequent Clan Invasion signaled the end of the Bullshark, with Majesty Metals reallocating resources to more profitable projects. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Entering production in 2519 the FLE-14 Flea was an attempt to create an ultra-light BattleMech. Weighing a mere fifteen tons, it could arguably be regarded as a different 'Mech design than the true Flea. It was capable of a maximum ground speed of nearly 150 km/h with a 120 meter jump capability. Its weapons and armor however were very light: Only one ton of armor protected the unit, and the single Medium Laser mounted in the right arm was barely enough to make it a viable battlefield unit. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: FLE-14跳蚤于2519年投产，是一次打造超轻型战斗机甲的尝试。它仅重十五吨，可以说已算是一种不同于真正跳蚤的机甲设计。它最高地面速度接近150公里/小时，跳跃能力120米。但它的武器与装甲都非常轻薄：只有一吨装甲保护该单位，右臂那唯一一门中型激光器勉强让它成为可用的战场单位。 特质: 改进生命维持 投放成本倍率: 0.97

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of two common refits for the FLE-14 ultralight scout, the -14B replaces one of the jump jets with slightly more armor and a rocket launcher. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为FLE-14超轻型侦察机甲两种常见改装之一，-14B把一个跳跃推进器换成稍多一些的装甲和一具火箭发射器。 特质: 改进生命维持 投放成本倍率: 0.97

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A common refit of the FLE-14, dropping one of the jump jets to mount more armor. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是FLE-14的常见改装，拆掉一个跳跃推进器以加装更多装甲。 特质: 改进生命维持 投放成本倍率: 0.97

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An expensive mech that is good against other 20-ton mechs and infantry but not able to stand up to any major threat from larger mechs. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一台昂贵的机甲，对付其他20吨机甲与步兵不错，但无力抵挡更大机甲带来的任何重大威胁。 特质: 改进生命维持 投放成本倍率: 0.95 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A refitted version of the Flea FLE-15 fielded by the Wolf's Dragoons in their attempts to not look inconspicuous with all the for Inner Sphere advanced and unknown 'Mechs. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是狼族龙骑兵使用的跳蚤FLE-15改装版，为的是不让他们带着一堆内天体先进且未知的机甲显得那么扎眼。 特质: 改进生命维持 投放成本倍率: 1.03 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Built as part of the Wolf's Dragoons exclusive contract with Earthwerks Incorporated to replenish the Dragoon's losses at the end of the Fourth Succession War, alongside renewed production of original Fleas, the FLE-16 was the first new production model of the extremely rare 'Mech in centuries. The variant remedied the earlier FLE-14's weaknesses by combining incredible speed with additional armor and weaponry on a 20 ton chassis. The engine was upgraded to a GM 180 in order to reach a similar maximum ground speed of nearly 150 km/h. It mounts two Medium Lasers and an Flamer while retaining an armor profile like the earlier FLE-15. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为狼族龙骑兵与厄斯沃克斯公司独家合约的一部分——该合约旨在第四次继承战争结束时补充龙骑兵的损失——FLE-16伴随原版跳蚤的恢复生产而诞生，是这种极为稀有机甲数百年来首个新量产型号。该改型通过在20吨底盘上结合惊人的速度与额外装甲和武器，弥补了早期FLE-14的弱点。引擎升级为GM 180以达到接近150公里/小时的相近最高地面速度。它装有两门中型激光器和一具火焰喷射器，同时保持与早期FLE-15相似的装甲配置。 特质: 改进生命维持 投放成本倍率: 0.95 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally produced exclusively for the Dragoons until the Capellan Confederation acquired the design's blueprints via a Maskirovka raid during the 3040s, the post-Helm Memory Core FLE-17 variant is based on the older FLE-15 model. Since the Dragoons used the Flea in a recon role more than an antipersonnel 'Mech, Earthwerks conceived a new design by incorporating recovered technology. Retaining the design's maximum speed of 97.2 km/h, the addition of an Endo Steelchassis frees up weight for a MASC system that allows the 'Mech's speed to be pushed up to 129.6 km/h in short bursts. The increase of speed is required to ensure survival on the modern battlefield, as the FLE-17 is only clad in a pitiful three tons of Livingston Ceramics armor plating. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该型号最初只为龙骑兵独家生产，直到卡佩兰联邦在3040年代通过一次伪装局突袭获得其图纸；亥姆记忆核心之后的FLE-17改型以较老的FLE-15为基础。由于龙骑兵更多把跳蚤用于侦察而非反人员，厄斯沃克斯通过引入回收技术构想出新设计。它保留该设计97.2公里/小时的最高速度，加入内层钢底盘省出的重量用于一套MASC系统，使机甲速度可在短时冲刺中推高到129.6公里/小时。这种提速对于在现代战场上存活是必要的，因为FLE-17只披挂着可怜的三吨利文斯顿陶瓷装甲板。 特质: 改进生命维持 投放成本倍率: 0.97 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一台极轻的狙击机甲，配一门极大的激光器，但挨不住一击。 特质: 改进生命维持 投放成本倍率: 0.95 手臂驱动器限制: 左上, 右上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A refitted version of the Flea FLE-4 fielded by the Wolf's Dragoons in their attempts to not look inconspicuous with all the for Inner Sphere advanced and unknown 'Mechs. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
